data.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Playa del Carmen by IHG
data.address: Av. Constituyentes S/N, entre 10 Y 15 Nte, Centro, 77720 Playa del Carmen, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
In the town center and half a block from Quinta Alegria Shopping Mall, this informal hotel is 7 minutes' walk from the closest beach and 55 km from Cancun International Airport.
Unfussy rooms provide complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and safes, plus minifridges, microwaves and coffeemakers. Some add furnished balconies, and suites have sofabeds.
Parking is free, as is a breakfast buffet served in a streamlined dining room. A rooftop outdoor pool is flanked by a sundeck and a terrace offering views of the town. Other amenities consist of a gym and a lobby lounge.
